welcome:
`4You have died!`w

`gThe icy mist clears and you stand face to face with the Grim Reaper. His hollow eyes stare deep into your soul. A heavy voice echoes through the silence:`w

"Your time has come, mortal. But I am in a generous mood... If you grant me a precious Gem or sacrifice a part of your Experience, I shall return your mortal body to you instantly. What do you choose?"
wait_message: `gYou wander peacefully among the gravestones, waiting for a new day...`w
success_resurrect: `2The Grim Reaper laughs terrifyingly. A warm light flows through your veins... You have resurrected and may enter the Town Square once more!`w
rob_success_gold: `2You take a shovel and dig up an old grave... Beneath the rotting wood you find a hidden chest containing `y{gold} gold coins`2!`w
rob_success_gem: `cYou search a grand crypt and shiny stones catch your eye... You find `w{gems} gem`c!`w
rob_zombie_encounter: `4While digging, a rotting, cold hand suddenly grabs your ankle! A zombie crawls up from the earth and attacks you! (-{hp} HP)`w
rob_empty: You scour the misty graveyard for hours, but all graves seem to have been emptied already by grave robbers.
graveyard_intro:
`gThe world around you loses all color, fading into shades of ash gray and icy blue. You look down and realize your feet no longer touch the ground; you are a floating phantom. Between the cracked slabs and crooked gravestones, a gigantic figure rises in a jet-black cloak. A razor-sharp scythe glistens in the mist. Large, hollow eye sockets stare at you. It is `4Ramius`g, the Grim Reaper of Oaktaven. His voice sounds like stone scraping on ice:`w

'Ah... another soul who thought they could defy the Dragon. Welcome to my realm, mortal.'
ramius_start_fight: `4Ramius`g points a bony finger toward the deeper shadows of the graveyard. `w'Yonder roam the souls of those who refused to accept their fate. Bring them to order, and I shall consider granting you favor. Fail, and I shall laugh at you personally.'`w
ramius_resurrect_success: `4Ramius`2 weighs your earned favors in his palm. They glow with a dim light. With a deep, ominous sigh, he raises his scythe. `w'You have proven your worth in my shadow realm. Go on then... breathe again. But remember: I shall see you sooner than you think!' `2A bright flash pulls your soul back to the Town Square.`w
ramius_resurrect_fail: `4Ramius`4 strikes the frozen ground with the staff of his scythe. The blow echoes through your entire soul. `w'Mercy is not free, ghost! You have not amused or aided me nearly enough to reclaim your soul. Stay here and suffer until morning dawns!'`w
event_styx_text: `gYou encounter a wide, jet-black river flowing silently through the Underworld. At the shore lies a wooden raft. An old ferryman with a deep hood leans on his oar. `w'I can take you a bit downstream, ghost. But it will cost you some of your precious energy...'`w
event_styx_outcome: `2The raft glides through the icy mist. Along the way, the cold currents fish a lost memory out of the water. You earn `w{favor} Favor`2 and feel more strongly connected to the afterlife!`w
event_styx_leave: `wYou remain safely on the shore and watch the raft slowly disappear into the mist.`w
event_whispers_text: `gYou run into a gigantic wall of massive, black stone. If you listen closely, you hear thousands of voices whispering simultaneously from the stones. They are the secrets of the living that have seeped down here. One voice sounds very clear and speaks a name...`w
event_whispers_outcome: `2You press your ear against the freezing stone. The wall whispers a secret about the bank account of a living player! You remember it well for when you breathe again shortly.`w
event_whispers_secret: `ySECRET:`w {user} has `y{gold} gold pieces`w in the bank!
event_whispers_empty: `gThe wall remains silent. No secrets to be heard today.`w
event_whispers_leave: `wYou float away quickly before the voices can fill your head.`w
error_no_turns: `4You have no energy (turns) left to haunt!`w
haunt_success: `2You float to the inn and plague `c{username}`2! You feel your phantom energy fade.`w
haunt_no_players: `gThere are currently no living players in the inn to plague.`w
ramius_quote_1: `4Ramius:`w 'Gold? Take those shiny coins into your grave, traveler. The monsters in the forest feasted on them last night. Here in the netherworld, only your `cFavor`w counts.'
ramius_quote_2: `4Ramius:`w 'Did you know that if you force close the app during combat, I see that as a cowardly act? I will instantly take `43 of your daily turns`w as a penalty. I do not like cheaters.'
ramius_quote_3: `4Ramius:`w 'Do not look so fearfully at my scythe. Nowadays I only use it to trim the graveyard hedges. For you, a simple snap of my fingers is more than enough.'
ramius_quote_4: `4Ramius:`w 'The Town Square is very cozy right now. Pity you cannot be there, eh? Working hard in the forest is dangerous, sleeping in a grave is peaceful at least.'
ramius_quote_5: `4Ramius:`w 'Ah, you are married? How precious. Did you know your partner is probably partying hard in the inn right now, squandering your inheritance? Life passes quickly.'
ramius_quote_6: `4Ramius:`w 'When you are a ghost, you can float to the inn to torment the living. Nothing is as amusing as turning your rivals' beer sour. Give it a try!'
ramius_quote_7: `4Ramius:`w 'Every morning with the New Day, I do a major cleanup and resurrect all souls for free. Consider it a little gift from the bank of the afterlife.'
ramius_quote_8: `4Ramius:`w 'People spend millions of gold at Merilon for beautiful armor. Yet they all end up right here, flat on their backs. Fashion does not protect you from eternity.'
ramius_quote_9: `4Ramius:`w 'Your Master on the training field hit you a bit too hard, didn't he? No worries, those men send dozens of apprentices to me every week. You are not the first.'
ramius_quote_10: `4Ramius:`w 'The Green Dragon is my best customer. He delivers a handful of overconfident adventurers to me every day. I should really send him a thank-you note.'
ramius_quote_11: `4Ramius:`w 'What are you doing floating around? Your transparency does not flatter you. Go whack some spirits or plague the living, make yourself useful!'
ramius_quote_12: `4Ramius:`w 'Gathering Favor becomes a bit harder every time your level increases. I simply expect higher quality from an experienced soul than from a novice.'
ramius_quote_13: `4Ramius:`w 'The dwarf in the bank thinks he is greedy with his two percent interest. I am the truly greedy one. I keep the souls of the entire world in my back pocket.'
ramius_quote_14: `4Ramius:`w 'Are you back here already? We had a whole conversation last week. You really need to learn how the Flee button works in the forest.'
ramius_quote_15: `4Ramius:`w 'Hush... do you hear that? That is the sound of the database quietly wiping your lost gold to zero. A beautiful, soothing sound, don't you think?'
